_meta.indication: CERIANNA is indicated for use with positron emission tomography (PET) imaging for the detection of estrogen receptor (ER)-positive lesions as an adjunct to biopsy in patients with recurrent or metastatic breast cancer.

pivotal_trials.design: Phase 3, prospective, non-randomized, single-center cohort study with blinded, central independent image interpretation.
pivotal_trials.population: Women with histologically confirmed invasive breast cancer with first known or suspected recurrence of treated breast cancer or stage IV metastatic breast cancer; all 90 participants were Korean women.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Agreement between qualitative FES scan interpretation and pathologically based ER status (positive and negative percent agreement, PPA/NPA).
pivotal_trials.n: 90 patients completed the FES PET scan; 85 patients included in the efficacy analysis (47 ER-positive, 38 ER-negative).
pivotal_trials.result: FES scan positive in 36 of 47 ER-positive patients (PPA 76.6%); all 38 ER-negative patients had negative FES PET (NPA 100%); positive predictive agreement 100%, negative predictive agreement 77.6%.

key_safety: Safety evaluated in published studies of 1207 patients; reported adverse reactions (each occurring at a rate <1%) were injection-site pain and dysgeusia. In Study 1, the most common adverse event was procedural pain in 9 (10%) of 90 patients; no serious adverse events occurred.
target_moa: Fluoroestradiol F 18 is a fluorinated synthetic derivative of 17β-estradiol that binds with competitive high affinity to estrogen receptors (ER-α and ER-β); its mechanism of action is via ER binding, and PET imaging detects its uptake in ER-positive tissue.

rems.type: According to the Division of Risk Management (DRISK), there is substantial safety information concerning this product and a REMS is not needed.

advisory_committee.vote: No advisory committee meeting was held; the application was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because it did not raise significant public health questions.

basis.text: The application was reviewed under Standard review.
